lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੀ ਤਿਸ ਵਿਟਉ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਜੋ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੀ ਦਿਖਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau jeeu karee tis vitau chau kha(n)neeai jo mai piree dikhaavae ||
lines.translation: I would cut my living body into four pieces for anyone who shows me my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਲਾਵਏ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har hoi daiaal taa(n) gur pooraa melaavae ||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord becomes merciful, then He leads us to meet the Perfect Guru. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar jor haumai tan maaiaa kooRee aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: The power of egotism prevails within, and the body is controlled by Maya; the false ones come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kaa phuramaaiaa ma(n)n na sakee dutar tariaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: If someone does not obey the Command of the True Guru, he cannot cross over the treacherous world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare jis aapanee so chalai satigur bhaai ||
lines.translation: Whoever is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kaa darasan saphal hai jo ichhai so phal paai ||
lines.translation: The Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan is fruitful; through it, one obtains the fruits of his desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਨਿਆਂ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee satigur ma(n)niaa(n) hau tin ke laagau paai ||
lines.translation: I touch the feet of those who believe in and obey the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kaa daas hai j anadin rahai liv laai ||6||
lines.translation: Nanak is the slave of those who, night and day, remain lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa piree piaar bin darasan kiu tripateeai ||
lines.translation: Those who are in love with their Beloved - how can they find satisfaction without His Darshan?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mile subhaai guramukh ihu man rahaseeai ||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meet Him with ease, and this mind blossoms forth in joy. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਪਿਰ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa piree piaar kiu jeevan pir baahare ||
lines.translation: Those who are in love with their Beloved - how can they live without Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਥੀਵਨਿ ਭੀ ਹਰੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) sahu dekhan aapanaa naanak theevan bhee hare ||8||
lines.translation: When they see their Husband Lord, O Nanak, they are rejuvenated. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਤੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa guramukh a(n)dar nehu tai preetam sachai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who are filled with love for You, my True Beloved,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਅਤੈ ਡੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: raatee atai dehu naanak prem samaaiaa ||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, remain immersed in the Lord's Love, night and day. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਆਸਕੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sachee aasakee jit preetam sachaa paaeeai ||
lines.translation: The love of the Gurmukh is true; through it, the True Beloved is attained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹਹਿ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: anadin rahahi ana(n)d naanak sahaj samaaeeai ||10||
lines.translation: Night and day, remain in bliss, O Nanak, immersed in intuitive peace and poise. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa prem piaar gur poore te paaeeai ||
lines.translation: True love and affection are obtained from the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੰਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: kabahoo na hovai bha(n)g naanak har gun gaaeeai ||11||
lines.translation: They never break, O Nanak, if one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਨੑਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa a(n)dar sachaa nehu kiu jeevanhi piree vihooniaa ||
lines.translation: How can those who have true love within them live without their Husband Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh mele aap naanak chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||12||
lines.translation: The Lord unites the Gurmukhs with Himself, O Nanak; they were separated from Him for such a long time. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਤਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau prem piaar tau aape laaiaa karam kar ||
lines.translation: You grant Your Grace to those whom You Yourself bless with love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak lehu milaai mai jaachik deejai naam har ||13||
lines.translation: O Lord, please let Nanak meet with You; please bless this beggar with Your Name. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hasai guramukh rovai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh laughs, and the Gurmukh cries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: j guramukh kare saaee bhagat hovai ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Gurmukh does, is devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s kare veechaar ||
lines.translation: Whoever becomes Gurmukh contemplates the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naanak paavai paar ||14||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, crosses over to the other shore. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar naam nidhaan hai gurabaanee veechaar ||
lines.translation: Those who have the Naam within, contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin ke mukh sad ujale tit sachai darabaar ||
lines.translation: Their faces are always radiant in the Court of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin bahadiaa uthadiaa kade na visarai j aap bakhase karataar ||
lines.translation: Sitting down and standing up, they never forget the Creator, who forgives them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh mile na vichhuRahi j mele sirajanahaar ||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are united with the Lord. Those united by the Creator Lord, shall never be separated again. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾਂ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮਹਾਂ ਕਰੜੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur peeraa(n) kee chaakaree mahaa(n) karaRee sukh saar ||
lines.translation: To work for the Guru, or a spiritual teacher, is terribly difficult, but it brings the most excellent peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਏ ਹੇਤ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare jis aapanee tis laae het piaar ||
lines.translation: The Lord casts His Glance of Grace, and inspires love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevai lagiaa bhaujal tarai sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Joined to the service of the True Guru, the mortal being crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paaisee a(n)tar bibek beechaar ||
lines.translation: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, with clear contemplation and discriminating understanding within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur miliai prabh paaeeai sabh dookh nivaaranahaar ||16||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, God is found; He is the Eradicator of all sorrow. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sevaa jo kare doojai bhaai chit laai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh may perform service, but his consciousness is attached to the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: put kalat kuta(n)b hai maaiaa mohu vadhaai ||
lines.translation: Through Maya, his emotional attachment to children, spouse and relatives increases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daragahi lekhaa ma(n)geeai koee a(n)t na sakee chhadaai ||
lines.translation: He shall be called to account in the Court of the Lord, and in the end, no one will be able to save him.
